list.title: Content
list.emptyHint: Create a story, game or activity that builds on what the child loves and is good at.

groupHints.draft: Check and approve before using with the child.
groupHints.approved: Approved. Present it or do it together, then tell how it went.
groupHints.completed: Already used. You can use it again or add more feedback.
groupHints.archived: Put aside. Duplicate one to use it again.

create.title: Create content
create.noFocus: There is no active focus area yet
create.noFocusHint: Add a focus area first, or choose Strength Builder.
create.typeStep: What would you like to create?
create.includeVideoHint: Off unless you switch it on. A video plan is a script and scenes; no video file is made yet.
create.videoNote: This creates a script and a list of scenes. A video file is not made yet.
create.languageHint: The child sees and hears the content in this language.
create.generatingHint: This can take up to a minute. You will review it before it is used.
create.ready: The draft is ready. Please review it.

review.approved: Approved. It is ready to use.
review.regeneratePlaceholder: For example: use buses instead of cars
review.regenerateBackToDraft: It goes back to draft so you can review it again.
review.regenerated: The new version is ready. Please review it.
review.unsharedToast: No longer shared with the parents.
review.shareNeedsApproval: Approve it first to share it with the parents.
review.archiveConfirm: Archive this content? You can still find it under Archived.
review.deleteConfirm: Delete this draft? This can't be undone.
review.draftNote: This is a draft. Check it, edit it if needed, then approve it before using it with the child.
review.completedNote: This content was used. To change it, duplicate it as a new draft.
review.archivedNote: This content is archived. Duplicate it to use it again.

editor.title: Title
editor.question: Question {n}

editor.unsafeHint: Children's content can't include clinical words, scores, percentages or web links.
editor.invalid: Some parts are empty or too long. Check the fields and try again.

feedback.title: How did it go?
feedback.subtitle: One tap is enough. The details are optional.
feedback.observePlaceholder: For example: joined after a prompt and stayed for a while
feedback.saved: Thank you! It was added to the timeline.
